reason: The vendor turn map leaves the ACP protocol for a transport-neutral owner: protocol_turn is rebuilt as vendor_turn, with its turn and prompt columns renamed run_id and address and its last column, which nothing read, dropped. The work is one full copy of protocol_turn into the new table, a DROP of the old table and a fresh (thread_id, ordinal) index; the new vendor_session entity starts empty. The only size sample is the one taken when the run_cost migration was authored on one development machine (protocol_turn 193 rows, max rowid 210); the installation estimates the copy from max(rowid) before replacing the running server.
